item: Route-caller ratchet: a word composes only when it is added to that head (Lane M, R684)
summary: The #35 ratchet completed a head literal ending in / with ANY word in the file, so simple.js (POST /api/sources/ beside a view named search) read as calling GET /api/sources/search and #1966 had to post to /api/sources/? to dodge it. Composition now takes only what is concatenated onto that head: a literal, a parenthesised expression's literals, or the literals assigned to the variable added. The called-route set on main is unchanged; simple.js is back to /api/sources/.
